sql:
SELECT j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active, f.fn
FROM cron.job j
CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['daily-summary', 'smart-alerts', 'support-chat', 'monthly-review', 'rescue-orphan-leads', 'fix-exif-rotation', 'upload-carrossel-photos', 'migrate-aventura-images', 'migrate-castelo-materials', 'link-orphan-conversations', 'scd-discover', 'fix-text']) AS f(fn)
WHERE j.command ILIKE '%' || f.fn || '%'
ORDER BY 1
